commands.command: Diagnose why M129 improves fixed-corpus loss but weakens fresh strict outcome-surface diversity, then propose or test a proof-surface-retention repair before PPO.
commands.name: m131_proof_surface_retention_repair

decision_rule: Do not start PPO until the objective recipe preserves fresh strict outcome-surface diversity as well as behavior retention.
failure_criteria: fresh selected physical pairs remain below the M122/M127 proof-surface thresholds
hypothesis: M129 overfits the deduplicated corpus enough to reduce fresh proof-surface diversity. A repair should explicitly retain or mine fresh outcome-surface diversity instead of optimizing only fixed snippets.
success_criteria: fresh proof-surface diversity recovers relative to M129
behavior retention remains at M124 level
the repair is evaluated on fresh miner seeds
PPO readiness is still decided by gates, not objective loss alone
